summary: Reviewed git diff d8466a7 (src/advice/grade.ts finitePct guard plus two test files). Focus item, the RangeError message echoing String(value): the echoed value is a recommendation equity field typed number | undefined, produced by in-process recommenders (recommendPostflop / preflop chart) from engine state, not from user, network, file or env input (spec section 8: no new trust boundary). It carries no secret or personal data, only a percent such as NaN, Infinity or undefined. String() on any runtime value either returns a string or throws, so the error still fails closed; the message is plain text in an Error, not interpolated into HTML, SQL, shell or a regex, and it matches the existing equity.ts pattern (Invalid card: ${String(card)}). The guard fails closed: NaN, plus or minus Infinity, missing and non-number values all throw before a margin is computed, so no NaN or null margin reaches a hand record. No new dependencies, randomness, file I/O or logging. No findings.
